title: Cloud Certification Preparation
subject: CLOUD SOLUTIONS
description: A vendor-neutral approach to cloud certifications: understand the exam blueprint, practise in a sandbox account, and turn knowledge into design decisions.

lessons.title: Reading the exam blueprint
lessons.body:
Every cloud certification publishes an exam guide or blueprint listing the domains, their weights, and the skills measured. Print it, and rate your confidence in each domain from one to five.

Use the lowest-rated domains to set your study priorities. A domain with a high weight and low confidence should come first.

lessons.title: Hands-on practice in a sandbox
lessons.body:
Cloud exams reward candidates who have used the services. Most providers offer free tiers or sandbox accounts. Set a spending alert before you start, and delete resources when a lab ends, so costs do not build up.

Useful exercises include creating a virtual network with private and public subnets, deploying a virtual machine with restricted access, configuring storage with access policies, and reviewing a billing report.

lessons.title: From knowledge to design decisions
lessons.body:
Many questions are scenarios: a business needs high availability, low cost, or strict data controls, and you choose the best design. Practise asking the same questions each time:

- What are the availability and recovery targets?
- What are the cost and performance constraints?
- Where must the data be kept, and who may access it?
- What is the simplest option that meets the requirement?

The correct answer is usually the one that meets every stated requirement with the least complexity.

lessons.title: Practice exams and review
lessons.body:
Use practice exams in the final weeks. Take them under timed conditions. After each one, review every question, including those you got right, because a lucky guess does not show understanding.

Keep a list of the services and concepts that caused errors. Review that list on the day before the exam.
